Attribute.name: alpha
Attribute.comment: 窗口的alpha值(0-255),别名opacity,如(100)

Attribute.name: bktrans
Attribute.comment: 窗口是否使用静态透明背景,别名layered,如(false)

Attribute.name: caption
Attribute.comment: 窗口可拖动的标题栏大小的边距,最后一个参数是指离上边框的距离,如(0,0,0,28)

Attribute.name: defaultfontcolor
Attribute.comment: 默认的字体颜色,如(0xFF000000)

Attribute.name: disabledfontcolor
Attribute.comment: 默认的disabled字体颜色,如(0xFFA7A6AA)

Attribute.name: gdiplustext
Attribute.comment: 是否用gdi+渲染文字（抗锯齿效果更好，默认开启，但是效率低）

Attribute.name: layeredimage
Attribute.comment: 分层窗口的背景图像描述；设置后自动启用分层窗口（layered=true），支持file/res/restype/mask等图片描述参数

Attribute.name: linkfontcolor
Attribute.comment: 默认的link字体颜色,如(0xFF0000FF)

Attribute.name: linkhoverfontcolor
Attribute.comment: 默认的linkhoverfont字体颜色,如(0xFFD3215F)

Attribute.name: mininfo
Attribute.comment: 窗口最小大小,如(320,240)

Attribute.name: noactivate
Attribute.comment: 鼠标按下控件时不主动将焦点设置到绘图区窗口；仅影响UIManager处理的鼠标按下消息，不等同于Windows的WS_EX_NOACTIVATE

Attribute.name: roundcorner
Attribute.comment: 窗口圆角大小,如(4,4)

Attribute.name: selectedcolor
Attribute.comment: 默认的selected字体颜色,如(0xFFBAE4FF)

Attribute.name: shadowcolor
Attribute.comment: 算法阴影的颜色，RGB格式，不支持透明度，使用shadowdarkness设置透明度

Attribute.name: shadowcorner
Attribute.comment: 图片阴影的九宫格描述

Attribute.name: shadowdarkness
Attribute.comment: 算法阴影的深度(相当于透明度)

Attribute.name: shadowimage
Attribute.comment: 阴影图片，使用此属性后自动屏蔽算法阴影(不支持source等属性设置)

Attribute.name: shadowposition
Attribute.comment: 算法阴影的偏移量

Attribute.name: shadowsharpness
Attribute.comment: 算法阴影的锐度

Attribute.name: shadowsize
Attribute.comment: 算法阴影的宽度(-20到20)

Attribute.name: showdirty
Attribute.comment: 显示本次重绘的脏区域矩形，用于调试重绘范围；分层窗口模式下不绘制

Attribute.name: showshadow
Attribute.comment: 是否启用窗体阴影

Attribute.name: size
Attribute.comment: 窗口的初始化大小,如(800,600)

Attribute.name: sizebox
Attribute.comment: 窗口可拖动改变窗口大小的边距,如(4,4,6,6)

Attribute.name: textrenderinghint
Attribute.comment: gdi+渲染文字提示（0-5），字体大的时候可以设置为4

Attribute.name: tooltiphovertime
Attribute.comment: 鼠标悬停触发跟踪/提示的延时，单位毫秒；默认400。当Tooltip窗口已创建时，实际初始延时优先取Tooltip窗口的TTDT_INITIAL设置

Attribute.name: count
Attribute.comment: 嵌入的次数

Attribute.name: source
Attribute.comment: XML布局文件

Attribute.name: bkcolor
Attribute.comment: 背景颜色,如(0xFFFF0000),别名bkcolor1

Attribute.name: bkcolor2
Attribute.comment: 背景渐变色2,和bkcolor配合使用,如(0xFFFFFF00)

Attribute.name: bkcolor3
Attribute.comment: 背景渐变色3,和bkcolor、bkcolor2配合使用,如(0xFFFF00FF)

Attribute.name: bkimage
Attribute.comment: 背景图片,如(bk.bmp或file='aaa.jpg' res='' restype='0' dest='0,0,0,0' source='0,0,0,0' corner='0,0,0,0' mask='#FF0000' fade='255' hole='false' xtiled='false' ytiled='false')

Attribute.name: bordercolor
Attribute.comment: 边框颜色,如(0xFF000000)

Attribute.name: borderround
Attribute.comment: 边框圆角半径,如(2,2)

Attribute.name: bordersize
Attribute.comment: 可以设置INT或RECT类型的值。当值为ING时则左、上、右、下都用该值作为宽。值为RECT类型时则分别设置左、上、右、下的边框

Attribute.name: borderstyle
Attribute.comment: 边框样式的设置,数值范围0-5

Attribute.name: bottombordersize
Attribute.comment: 底部边框大小，如(1)，设置该值大于0，则将忽略bordersize属性的设置

Attribute.name: colorhsl
Attribute.comment: 本控件的颜色是否随窗口的hsl变化而变化,如(false)

Attribute.name: cursor
Attribute.comment: 光标：arrow,cross,hand,ibeam,icon,no,size,sizeall,sizenesw,sizens,sizenwse,sizewe,uparrow,wait

Attribute.name: drag
Attribute.comment: 是否允许从该控件开始拖拽；必须同时通过m_pm.EnableDragDrop(true)启用拖拽支持

Attribute.name: drop
Attribute.comment: 设置控件的接收拖放标志；当前源码未生效

Attribute.name: enabled
Attribute.comment: 是否可以响应用户操作,如(true)

Attribute.name: float
Attribute.comment: 是否使用绝对定位,如(true)

Attribute.name: floatalign
Attribute.comment: 用于控制float控件先对于父控件的对齐方式（left\center\right、top\vcenter\bottom）

Attribute.name: focusbordercolor
Attribute.comment: 获得焦点时边框的颜色,如(0xFFFF0000)

Attribute.name: forecolor
Attribute.comment: 前景颜色

Attribute.name: foreimage
Attribute.comment: 前景图片

Attribute.name: gradient
Attribute.comment: 背景渐变方向；值为hor时水平渐变，其他值（包括空值）为垂直渐变，仅在bkcolor2或bkcolor3生效时可见

Attribute.name: height
Attribute.comment: 控件预设的高度，如(30)

Attribute.name: innerstyle
Attribute.comment: 通过样式表设置控件的样式

Attribute.name: keyboard
Attribute.comment: 非CButtonUI类忽略该值，为false时不支持TAB_STOP,且该对象不处理键盘信息

Attribute.name: leftbordersize
Attribute.comment: 左边边框大小，如(1)，设置该值大于0，则将忽略bordersize属性的设置

Attribute.name: maxheight
Attribute.comment: 控件的最大高度，如(30)

Attribute.name: maxwidth
Attribute.comment: 控件的最大宽度，如(100)

Attribute.name: menu
Attribute.comment: 是否需要右键菜单,如(true)

Attribute.name: minheight

Attribute.name: minwidth
Attribute.comment: 控件的最小宽度，如(100)

Attribute.name: name
Attribute.comment: 控件名字，同一窗口内必须唯一，如(testbtn)

Attribute.name: pos
Attribute.comment: 位置，如果为float控件则指定位置和大小，否则只指定大小,如(0,0,100,100)

Attribute.name: resourcetext
Attribute.comment: 是否支持多语言，为true文字绘制会走多语言接口

Attribute.comment: 通过样式名称设置控件的样式

Attribute.name: text
Attribute.comment: 显示文本,如(测试文本)

Attribute.name: tooltip
Attribute.comment: 鼠标悬浮提示,如(请在这里输入你的密码)

Attribute.name: topbordersize
Attribute.comment: 顶部边框大小，如(1)，设置该值大于0，则将忽略bordersize属性的设置

Attribute.name: userdata
Attribute.comment: 自定义标识

Attribute.name: virtualwnd
Attribute.comment: 设置控件的虚拟窗体的名字

Attribute.name: visible
Attribute.comment: 是否可见,如(true)

Attribute.name: width
Attribute.comment: 控件预设的宽度，如(100)

Attribute.name: childalign
Attribute.comment: 子控件整体水平对齐,取值left、center、right,仅当没有可伸缩子控件时生效

Attribute.name: childpadding
Attribute.comment: 子控件之间的额外距离,如(4)

Attribute.name: childvalign
Attribute.comment: 子控件整体垂直对齐,取值top、vcenter、bottom,仅当没有可伸缩子控件时生效

Attribute.name: fixedscrollbar
Attribute.comment: 是否固定滚动条,滚动条常驻不按内容自动显示隐藏

Attribute.name: hscrollbar
Attribute.comment: 是否使用横向滚动条,如(true)

Attribute.name: hscrollbarstyle
Attribute.comment: 设置本容器的横向滚动条的样式

Attribute.name: inset
Attribute.comment: 容器的内边距,如(2,2,2,2)

Attribute.name: mousechild
Attribute.comment: 本控件的子控件是否可以响应用户操作,如(true)

Attribute.name: scrollstepsize
Attribute.comment: 容器的滚动条滚动步长，0代表使用默认步长

Attribute.name: showscrollbar
Attribute.comment: 是否显示滚动条,同时控制横向与竖向滚动条

Attribute.name: vscrollbar
Attribute.comment: 是否使用竖向滚动条,如(true)

Attribute.name: vscrollbarstyle
Attribute.comment: 设置本容器的纵向滚动条的样式

Attribute.name: sep
Attribute.comment: 分隔符宽,别名sepwidth,正负表示分隔符在左边还是右边,如(-4)

Attribute.name: sepimm
Attribute.comment: 拖动分隔符是否立即改变大小,如(false)

Attribute.name: editmaxchar
Attribute.comment: 跳转输入框最大输入字符数,如(3)

Attribute.name: font
Attribute.comment: 页码字体id,如(0)

Attribute.name: gotoeditbordercolor
Attribute.comment: 跳转输入框边框颜色,如(0xFF000000)

Attribute.name: gotoeditbordersize
Attribute.comment: 跳转输入框边框大小,如(1)

Attribute.name: maxpage
Attribute.comment: 最大页数与每屏显示页数,两个整数以空格分隔,如(10 5)

Attribute.name: pagebkcolor
Attribute.comment: 页背景颜色,如(0xFFFFFFFF)

Attribute.name: pagehotbkcolor
Attribute.comment: 悬浮页背景颜色,如(0xFFC3C3C3)

Attribute.name: pagehottextcolor
Attribute.comment: 悬浮页文本颜色,如(0xFF000000)

Attribute.name: pageselectedbkcolor
Attribute.comment: 选中页背景颜色,如(0xFFFF0000)

Attribute.name: pageselectedtextcolor
Attribute.comment: 选中页文本颜色,如(0xFF00FF00)

Attribute.name: pagetextcolor
Attribute.comment: 普通页文本颜色,如(0xFF000000)

Attribute.name: bkcolor
Attribute.comment: 背景颜色,如(0xFFFF0000),别名bkcolor1

Attribute.name: bkcolor2
Attribute.comment: 背景渐变色2,和bkcolor配合使用,如(0xFFFFFF00)

Attribute.name: bkcolor3
Attribute.comment: 背景渐变色3,和bkcolor、bkcolor2配合使用,如(0xFFFF00FF)

Attribute.name: bkimage
Attribute.comment: 背景图片,如(bk.bmp或file='aaa.jpg' res='' restype='0' dest='0,0,0,0' source='0,0,0,0' corner='0,0,0,0' mask='#FF0000' fade='255' hole='false' xtiled='false' ytiled='false')

Attribute.name: bordercolor
Attribute.comment: 边框颜色,如(0xFF000000)

Attribute.name: borderround
Attribute.comment: 边框圆角半径,如(2,2)

Attribute.name: bordersize
Attribute.comment: 可以设置INT或RECT类型的值。当值为ING时则左、上、右、下都用该值作为宽。值为RECT类型时则分别设置左、上、右、下的边框

Attribute.name: borderstyle
Attribute.comment: 边框样式的设置,数值范围0-5

Attribute.name: bottombordersize
Attribute.comment: 底部边框大小，如(1)，设置该值大于0，则将忽略bordersize属性的设置

Attribute.name: colorhsl
Attribute.comment: 本控件的颜色是否随窗口的hsl变化而变化,如(false)

Attribute.name: cursor
Attribute.comment: 光标：arrow,cross,hand,ibeam,icon,no,size,sizeall,sizenesw,sizens,sizenwse,sizewe,uparrow,wait

Attribute.name: drag
Attribute.comment: 是否允许从该控件开始拖拽；必须同时通过m_pm.EnableDragDrop(true)启用拖拽支持

Attribute.name: drop
Attribute.comment: 设置控件的接收拖放标志；当前源码未生效

Attribute.name: enabled
Attribute.comment: 是否可以响应用户操作,如(true)

Attribute.name: float
Attribute.comment: 是否使用绝对定位,如(true)

Attribute.name: floatalign
Attribute.comment: 用于控制float控件先对于父控件的对齐方式（left\center\right、top\vcenter\bottom）

Attribute.name: focusbordercolor
Attribute.comment: 获得焦点时边框的颜色,如(0xFFFF0000)

Attribute.name: forecolor
Attribute.comment: 前景颜色

Attribute.name: foreimage
Attribute.comment: 前景图片

Attribute.name: gradient
Attribute.comment: 背景渐变方向；值为hor时水平渐变，其他值（包括空值）为垂直渐变，仅在bkcolor2或bkcolor3生效时可见

Attribute.name: height
Attribute.comment: 控件预设的高度，如(30)

Attribute.name: innerstyle
Attribute.comment: 通过样式表设置控件的样式

Attribute.name: keyboard
Attribute.comment: 非CButtonUI类忽略该值，为false时不支持TAB_STOP,且该对象不处理键盘信息

Attribute.name: leftbordersize
Attribute.comment: 左边边框大小，如(1)，设置该值大于0，则将忽略bordersize属性的设置

Attribute.name: maxheight
Attribute.comment: 控件的最大高度，如(30)

Attribute.name: maxwidth
Attribute.comment: 控件的最大宽度，如(100)

Attribute.name: menu
Attribute.comment: 是否需要右键菜单,如(true)

Attribute.name: minheight
Attribute.comment: 控件的最小高度，如(30)

Attribute.name: minwidth
Attribute.comment: 控件的最小宽度，如(100)

Attribute.name: mouse
Attribute.comment: 本控件是否可以响应鼠标操作,如(true)

Attribute.name: name
Attribute.comment: 控件名字，同一窗口内必须唯一，如(testbtn)

Attribute.name: pos
Attribute.comment: 位置，如果为float控件则指定位置和大小，否则只指定大小,如(0,0,100,100)

Attribute.name: resourcetext
Attribute.comment: 是否支持多语言，为true文字绘制会走多语言接口

Attribute.name: richevent
Attribute.comment: 为true时控件会额外发送buttondown/mouseenter/mouseleave等富事件通知，仅部分控件(如Button/List)响应

Attribute.name: rightbordersize
Attribute.comment: 右边边框大小，如(1)，设置该值大于0，则将忽略bordersize属性的设置

Attribute.name: shortcut
Attribute.comment: 对应的快捷键,如(P)

Attribute.name: style
Attribute.comment: 通过样式名称设置控件的样式

Attribute.name: text
Attribute.comment: 显示文本,如(测试文本)

Attribute.comment: 鼠标悬浮提示,如(请在这里输入你的密码)

Attribute.name: topbordersize
Attribute.comment: 顶部边框大小，如(1)，设置该值大于0，则将忽略bordersize属性的设置

Attribute.comment: 自定义标识

Attribute.name: virtualwnd
Attribute.comment: 设置控件的虚拟窗体的名字

Attribute.name: visible
Attribute.comment: 是否可见,如(true)

Attribute.name: width
Attribute.comment: 控件预设的宽度，如(100)

Attribute.name: align
Attribute.comment: 文字横向对齐方式,取值left、center、right

Attribute.name: autocalcheight
Attribute.comment: 是否自动计算高度

Attribute.name: autocalcwidth
Attribute.comment: 是否自动计算宽度

Attribute.name: disabledtextcolor
Attribute.comment: disabled字体颜色，0表示使用默认disabled字体颜色,如(0xFFFF0000)

Attribute.name: endellipsis
Attribute.comment: 句末显示不全是否使用...代替,如(true)

Attribute.name: font
Attribute.comment: 字体id,如(0)

Attribute.name: noprefix
Attribute.comment: 是否禁用&字符转义为下划线,true时&原样显示

Attribute.name: showhtml
Attribute.comment: 是否使用类html富文本绘制,如(false)

Attribute.name: textcolor
Attribute.comment: 字体颜色，0表示使用默认字体颜色,如(0xFFFF0000)

Attribute.name: textpadding
Attribute.comment: 文字显示的边距,如(2,2,2,2)

Attribute.name: valign
Attribute.comment: 文字纵向对齐方式,取值top、center、bottom

Attribute.name: wordbreak
